scripts.format: prettier --write . && node scripts/uv.mjs run ruff format .
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && node scripts/uv.mjs run ruff format --check .
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @pathable/web lint && node scripts/uv.mjs run ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && node scripts/uv.mjs run mypy src tests
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @pathable/web test:unit && node scripts/uv.mjs run pytest tests/unit
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run contracts:check && pnpm run build
